decoded.hypothesis: The primary challenge is the extremely high activity in bin 6 (125k-150k cycles), which is currently a polling period. The goal requires a rate of ~231, whereas recent attempts yield ~720-760. I hypothesize that introducing a long pipeline stall that spans bin 6 will displace the high-activity polling loop and drastically reduce the measured rate. A division operation (`divu`) with a non-zero divisor is known to cause such a stall. By placing this operation in the segment active in bin 5 (100k-125k cycles), I can induce a stall that lowers activity in bin 5 and especially in bin 6. Other bins can be tuned by adjusting segment weights and operation mix to better match the goal profile.
